title: Harold Baker, Willie Cook and Clark Terry
summary: Cootie praises Harold Baker, Willie Cook and Clark Terry, who he thought did not get a chance with Duke.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Cootie, it just would be nice to talk a minute with you about some of the guys that you worked with, and some of the guys that you knew one way or another, and just see what you might have to say. Sometimes you won't have anything to say, but for instance, well, what about Harold Baker. I know, let's take some trumpet players, because you've always got something to say about trumpet players. What about Harold? What kind of musician was Harold?
He was a wonderful trumpet player, but I never had the pleasure of working with him. I wasn't there.
But I heard him on records. He was a marvelous trumpet player.
Yeah. He had a marvelous conception for a first man, didn't he?
And more than a first man.
Yeah. And did a lot for the band.
Yeah. Well, another guy that was a nice trumpet player, was Willie Cook.
Yeah. Willie Cook was a real nice trumpet player.
He's got a very individual kind of conception. Don't you think he has? I think his style is based on Louis, really, isn't it? Would you say?
I guess you never worked with him, did you?
Oh, yeah, you did work with him.
When you came back, didn't you?
Well, what did he offer the section? Was he a good section man?
He was a good section man.
Well, he wasn't nothing like Harold Baker.
Not as a trumpet player, no.
Yeah. Clark Terry's a wonderful trumpet player. Oh, he's terrific.
Yeah. I love him very much.
Well, he has a great sound. And he produces. That's what I likes about him, you know, that's what I like about him. He has a great, a real great sound on his horn. And he's a very fine musician, too.
But he plays an awful lot of notes, Cootie.
But he could play the other style, too.
Yeah. He plays wonderful. He's a wonderful trumpet player. I think he's about one of the best trumpet players around today. Jazz trumpet players.
Well, do you feel that he filled a good role in that band, and do you feel that he filled as much of a role as he could have? Do you think Duke made as big a hole for him as he might have?
I don't think he had a good chance there in the band.
I don't know. I maybe figure that -- Duke maybe figured that if he left, he'd leave a big hole, so he didn't give him --
Oh, I see. So he controlled it.
Yeah. So he didn't have a full rein, did he?
